reading.zh: 按工具的数据流读：窗口负责交互，每次落点只在 geometry 里做一次坐标换算（归一化 0~1，X 自左向右、Y 自下向上），draft-store 负责草稿持久化，validator 是导出门禁，xlsx-exporter 按项目 7 行表头写出三处产物。
reading.en: Read as the tool's data flow: the window drives interaction, every click is converted once in geometry (normalised 0~1, X left-to-right, Y bottom-to-top), the draft store persists the workspace, the validator gates the export, and the xlsx exporter writes the three workbooks in the project's 7-row header format.
